title: Rarity Escalation Series
description: A reference-driven skinline series that escalates one heroine from base look to increasingly premium rarity tiers.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the core heroine and base cosmetic logic. Images 02-04 preserve the exact same identity while amplifying rarity, materials, VFX restraint, and commercial presentation.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-base-skin first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-rare-prism-upfit, 03-epic-storm-upfit, 04-legendary-solar-upfit. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-reference-base-skin is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
